paragraph.content: Liver warning: This product contains acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if your child takes:

list.item: more than 5 doses in 24 hours, which is the maximum daily amount

paragraph.content: Allergy alert: Acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions.

If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away
Sore throat warning: If sore throat is severe, persistent for more than 2 days, is accompanied
or followed by fever, headache, nausea, rash, or vomiting, consult a doctor promptly.

title.content: Stop use and ask a doctor if

list.item: pain gets worse or lasts more than 5 days
fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days

text.paragraph: These could be signs of a serious condition.

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

paragraph.content: Keep out of reach of children.

text.paragraph: Overdose warning: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Quick medical attention is critical for adults as well as for children even if you do not notice any signs or symptoms.
